description: When to come for the shortest wait at one place on a day, from that place's own past visits on that weekday over the last 8 weeks: the best time, the expected wait then, the expected wait through the day, and how busy each hour usually is. Pass `date` (YYYY-MM-DD in the place's time zone, today through 6 days ahead; default today). These are estimates, not promises: say "about". Use it when someone asks when it's least busy or when to come; for the wait right now use get_place. If the place is closed that day or hasn't enough past visits, it says so instead.

date.description: Optional date as YYYY-MM-DD, today through 6 days ahead (default today)
